Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to follow the Planner’s explicit instructions to open and extract information from authoritative sources (e.g., Britannica and other non-Wikipedia pages). Instead, it repeatedly reran similar DuckDuckGo searches and surfaced generic or Wikipedia-based snippets without advancing the investigation. This repetition and noncompliance initiated an unproductive loop, preventing confirmation of the 1st Virginia Regiment’s involvement and stalling the derivation of the correct answer (Lord Dunmore).
